headlines.title: Oil prices climb after reports of Saudi Aramco refinery being hit by Houthi rebels
headlines.summary: This is the whole tape right now — Houthi strikes on Saudi Aramco infrastructure, Hormuz traffic at multi-month lows, Iran threatening new restricted zones, and crude sitting near seven-week highs. Energy names, airlines, refiners, and the long bond are all getting repriced simultaneously. When the Strait of Hormuz sneezes, every asset class catches a cold.

headlines.title: Inflation data, Oracle earnings, and an energy supply crunch: What to watch this week
headlines.summary: The week's two biggest swing factors are sitting right here in one headline: a CPI print that could push the Fed toward a hike, and Oracle earnings that'll tell us whether Big Tech's AI capex story still has legs. Diesel prices feeding into core goods inflation is the sleeper here — the Morning Bid piece on diesel as the 'real spoiler for inflation doves' backs this up. Bonds, tech, and the whole rate-sensitive complex are on watch.

headlines.title: Far-right AfD landslide in German state piles pressure on federal government
headlines.summary: Called the 'most consequential German state-election result of the postwar era' — that's not hyperbole you ignore. European bond markets are already getting hit (Gilts, BTPs, OATs all selling off on energy shock and political risk), and a destabilized German federal government adds fiscal uncertainty to an already stressed eurozone. The euro and European equities are the direct plays; this one ripples into EM and dollar strength too.
